name: Krabbe Disease
confirmatory_tests: Galactocerebrosidase (GALC) enzyme assay in leukocytes
GALC gene sequencing (targeted / NGS)
Brain MRI (periventricular white matter demyelination, globoid cells)
Nerve conduction studies (demyelinating peripheral neuropathy)
CSF protein analysis (markedly elevated total protein)
pubmed_title: Early infantile Krabbe disease: Clinical trajectory, GALC pathogenic variants, and therapeutic frontiers.

name: Tay-Sachs Disease
confirmatory_tests: Beta-hexosaminidase A enzyme activity assay in serum/leukocytes
HEXA targeted molecular mutation analysis
Ophthalmological exam (macular cherry-red spot verification)
Brain MRI (cerebral white matter hypodensity with late cerebral atrophy)
pubmed_title: GM2 gangliosidoses update: Molecular pathophysiology and registry outcomes for infantile Tay-Sachs.

name: Canavan Disease
confirmatory_tests: Urine organic acids (elevated N-acetylaspartic acid / NAA by GC-MS)
Aspartoacylase (ASPA) enzyme assay in skin fibroblasts
ASPA gene sequence analysis
Proton MR spectroscopy (markedly elevated NAA peak in cerebral white matter)
pubmed_title: Canavan disease: Diagnostic hallmarks and recent clinical trials in adeno-associated viral gene therapy.

name: Gaucher Disease Type 1
confirmatory_tests: Beta-glucosidase (glucocerebrosidase) leukocyte enzyme assay (<15% normal)
GBA1 full gene sequencing
Serum chitotriosidase & glucosylsphingosine (Lyso-Gb1) biomarkers
Bone marrow biopsy (wrinkled-tissue-paper Gaucher cells)
Skeletal X-rays / MRI (Erlenmeyer flask deformity)
pubmed_title: Long-term real-world outcomes of substrate reduction and enzyme replacement therapy in Gaucher disease.

name: Fabry Disease
confirmatory_tests: Alpha-galactosidase A enzyme activity in plasma/leukocytes (males)
GLA gene sequencing (mandatory in females)
Plasma globotriaosylsphingosine (Lyso-Gb3) quantification
Slit lamp exam for cornea verticillata
Renal biopsy showing zebra bodies on electron microscopy
pubmed_title: Early clinical phenotypes and biomarkers in pediatric and young adult Fabry disease.

name: Niemann-Pick Disease Type C
confirmatory_tests: Plasma oxysterols (cholestane-3beta,5alpha,6beta-triol) biomarker assay
Filipin staining of cultured skin fibroblasts (free unesterified cholesterol)
NPC1 and NPC2 bidirectional DNA sequencing
Neurological video-oculography assessing vertical saccades
pubmed_title: Diagnostic Odyssey in Niemann-Pick Type C: Implementation of rapid biomarker panels.

name: Pompe Disease
confirmatory_tests: Acid alpha-glucosidase (GAA) enzyme activity assay in dried blood spots
GAA gene sequencing
Echocardiogram (massive concentric left ventricular hypertrophy in infants)
Serum creatine kinase (CK) measurement
Electromyography (myopathic pattern with pseudomyotonic discharges)
pubmed_title: Newborn screening and outcome trajectory for infantile and late-onset Pompe disease.

name: Wilson Disease
confirmatory_tests: Slit-lamp examination for Kayser-Fleischer (KF) rings in Descemet's membrane
Serum ceruloplasmin (<20 mg/dL)
24-hour urinary copper excretion (>100 mcg/24h)
ATP7B mutation analysis (duo/trio genetic testing)
Liver biopsy (hepatic parenchymal copper concentration >250 mcg/g dry weight)
pubmed_title: International consensus on the diagnosis and personalized therapy of Wilson disease.

name: Metachromatic Leukodystrophy
confirmatory_tests: Arylsulfatase A (ARSA) activity in leukocytes (<10% normal)
Urinary sulfatide excretion test by liquid chromatography-MS
ARSA gene sequencing and pseudodeficiency allele exclusion
Brain MRI (tigroid pattern of symmetric demyelination sparing U-fibers)
pubmed_title: Metachromatic leukodystrophy: Gene therapy and early neuro-monitoring outcomes.

name: X-linked Adrenoleukodystrophy
confirmatory_tests: Plasma very long-chain fatty acids (VLCFA - elevated C26:0, C24/C22, C26/C22)
ABCD1 targeted gene sequencing
Brain MRI with Loes scoring for cerebral demyelinating lesions
Serum morning ACTH and cortisol (adrenocortical evaluation)
pubmed_title: Newborn screening and MRI surveillance algorithm in X-linked adrenoleukodystrophy.

name: Ataxia-Telangiectasia
confirmatory_tests: Serum alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) level (significantly elevated)
ATM gene mutation analysis
Serum immunoglobulins (IgA, IgG subclasses deficiency)
Radiosensitivity chromosomal breakage assay in peripheral lymphocytes
pubmed_title: Ataxia-telangiectasia: Systematic immunological and neuro-protective management.

name: Spinal Muscular Atrophy Type 1
confirmatory_tests: SMN1 exon 7 and 8 homozygous deletion MLPA / qPCR assay
SMN2 copy number determination
Electromyography (severe denervation with fibrillation potentials)
Serum creatine kinase (normal to mildly elevated)
pubmed_title: Real-world efficacy of gene replacement and disease-modifying therapies in SMA type 1.

name: Mucopolysaccharidosis Type I
confirmatory_tests: Alpha-L-iduronidase leukocyte / fibroblast enzyme activity assay
Urinary glycosaminoglycans (GAGs - elevated heparan/dermatan sulfate)
IDUA gene molecular sequencing
Skeletal survey (dysostosis multiplex findings)
pubmed_title: Early diagnostic biomarkers in MPS I and hematopoietic stem cell transplantation timelines.

name: Classical Ehlers-Danlos Syndrome
confirmatory_tests: COL5A1 and COL5A2 gene sequencing and deletion/duplication testing
Clinical Beighton joint hypermobility score evaluation (>5/9)
Skin extensibility measurement (>1.5 cm on volar forearm)
Transmission electron microscopy of dermis (collagen flowers)
pubmed_title: Diagnostic criteria and vascular monitoring in classical and hypermobile Ehlers-Danlos syndromes.

name: Marfan Syndrome
confirmatory_tests: Transthoracic echocardiogram (aortic root Z-score >= 2.0)
Slit-lamp exam (bilateral superior temporal lens subluxation)
FBN1 gene pathogenic variant sequencing
Ghent-2 systemic feature clinical score calculation
pubmed_title: Cardiovascular risk stratification and angiotensin receptor blockade in Marfan syndrome.

name: Huntington Disease
confirmatory_tests: HTT gene CAG trinucleotide repeat expansion testing (>=36 repeats diagnostic)
Brain MRI / CT (bilateral caudate nucleus and putamen atrophy)
Unified Huntington's Disease Rating Scale (UHDRS) neurological evaluation
PET scan (decreased glucose metabolism in striatum)
pubmed_title: Huntingtin-lowering therapeutic strategies and clinical biomarker kinetics in Huntington disease.

name: Hereditary Angioedema
confirmatory_tests: Serum C4 level (consistently low even between attacks)
C1-inhibitor (C1-INH) antigenic protein level
C1-INH functional activity assay (<50% diagnostic)
SERPING1 gene sequence analysis
pubmed_title: Frailty in elderly with a rare genetic disease: a geriatric score analysis in C1 inhibitor Hereditary Angioedema.

name: Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis
confirmatory_tests: Electromyography & Nerve Conduction (active and chronic denervation in 3+ regions)
Brain & cervical spinal MRI (excluding structural compression, showing corticospinal hyperintensity)
Targeted gene panel (C9orf72 hexanucleotide repeat, SOD1)
Serum Neurofilament Light Chain (NfL) biomarker measurement
pubmed_title: Neurofilament light chain and targeted antisense therapeutics across ALS subtypes.

name: Friedreich Ataxia
confirmatory_tests: FXN gene intron 1 GAA triplet repeat expansion analysis (>66 repeats)
Echocardiogram (hypertrophic cardiomyopathy)
Sensory nerve conduction studies (absent or severely reduced sensory nerve action potentials)
Spinal cord MRI (atrophy of cervical spinal cord)
pubmed_title: Omaveloxolone and mitochondrial restoration therapy in Friedreich ataxia.

name: Sitosterolemia
confirmatory_tests: Gas chromatography-mass spectrometry (GC-MS) for serum plant sterols (sitosterol, campesterol >30-fold)
ABCG5 and ABCG8 bidirectional sequencing
Coronary calcium score / CT angiography
Platelet morphology evaluation on peripheral smear
pubmed_title: Sitosterolemia misdiagnosed as homozygous familial hypercholesterolemia: A diagnostic challenge.

name: Alkaptonuria
onset_range: Childhood to Adult (urine darkening in infancy, arthritis at 30+)
confirmatory_tests: Urinary homogentisic acid (HGA) quantification by GC-MS
HGD full gene molecular sequencing
Spine radiograph (intervertebral disc calcification / wafer-thin calcification)
Echocardiogram (aortic / mitral valve stenosis)
pubmed_title: Nitisinone disease modification in alkaptonuria: Long-term clinical and biochemical surveillance.

name: Nephropathic Cystinosis
confirmatory_tests: Intra-leukocytic cystine measurement (>3 nmol half-cystine/mg protein)
Slit-lamp exam showing pathognomonic tinsel-like corneal cystine crystals
CTNS gene common 57-kb deletion and Sanger sequencing
Urinary electrolyte analysis (aminoaciduria, glucosuria, phosphaturia)
pubmed_title: Cysteamine delayed-release pharmacokinetics and kidney survival in infantile nephropathic cystinosis.

name: Classic Homocystinuria
category: Inborn Error of Amino Acid Metabolism
confirmatory_tests: Total plasma homocysteine (>100 micromol/L) and elevated methionine
CBS gene mutation analysis
Cystathionine beta-synthase enzyme activity in cultured skin fibroblasts
Ophthalmology evaluation (downward/inward lens dislocation)
pubmed_title: Pyridoxine-responsive and non-responsive classic homocystinuria: Phenotypic and genetic landscape.

name: Maple Syrup Urine Disease
category: Inborn Error of Amino Acid Metabolism
confirmatory_tests: Plasma amino acid quantification (dramatically elevated leucine, isoleucine, valine, alloisoleucine)
BCKDHA, BCKDHB, and DBT gene sequencing
Urinary branched-chain 2-oxoacids by GC-MS
Brain MRI (diffuse intramyelinic cytotoxic edema / MSUD edema)
pubmed_title: Acute metabolic crisis protocol and long-term neurocognitive preservation in classic MSUD.

name: Phenylketonuria
category: Inborn Error of Amino Acid Metabolism
confirmatory_tests: Newborn dried blood spot / plasma phenylalanine level (>360 micromol/L)
PAH gene comprehensive molecular testing
Tetrahydrobiopterin (BH4) loading test to rule out pterin defects
Urine pterin profile analysis
pubmed_title: Lifelong dietary adherence and neurophysiological outcomes in adults with early-treated PKU.

name: Zellweger Syndrome
confirmatory_tests: Plasma very long chain fatty acids (VLCFA - C26:0 elevation, C26:1/C22:0 ratio)
Serum phytanic and pristanic acids quantification
PEX multigene panel sequencing
Abdominal ultrasound (cortical microcysts of the kidneys)
Knee X-ray (calcific chondrodysplasia punctata / patellar stippling)
pubmed_title: Zellweger spectrum disorders: Biomarker trajectory and phenotypic spectrum.

name: Charcot-Marie-Tooth Disease Type 1A
synonyms: Hereditary Motor and Sensory Neuropathy Type 1A
confirmatory_tests: MLPA / chromosomal microarray for 1.4-Mb PMP22 duplication on 17p12
Motor nerve conduction studies (uniform demyelinating slowing: median MNCV < 38 m/s)
Neurological examination (bilateral distal wasting, absent Achilles reflexes)
Sural nerve biopsy (rarely needed, onion bulb formation)
pubmed_title: Clinical outcome measures and peripheral nerve ultrasound in pediatric CMT1A.

name: Osteogenesis Imperfecta Type 1
confirmatory_tests: COL1A1 and COL1A2 targeted next-generation sequencing
Skeletal survey (osteopenia, multiple healing long bone / rib fractures, Wormian bones)
Dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry (DEXA) lumbar spine Z-score
Audiometry (progressive conductive / sensorineural hearing loss)
pubmed_title: Bisphosphonate optimization and fracture epidemiology in mild osteogenesis imperfecta.

name: Prader-Willi Syndrome
gene: SNRPN / snoRNAs (15q11.2-q13 paternal deletion / maternal UPD)
onset_range: Neonatal hypotonia evolving to hyperphagia in early childhood
confirmatory_tests: DNA methylation analysis of SNRPN locus (abnormal maternal-only methylation pattern >99% sensitive)
FISH or Chromosomal Microarray for 15q11.2-q13 deletion (65-75% cases)
Short tandem repeat (STR) marker analysis for maternal uniparental disomy 15 (UPD15)
Endocrine workup (growth hormone deficiency, hypogonadism)
pubmed_title: Transition from severe infant hypotonia to hyperphagic phase in Prader-Willi: Longitudinal biomarker profiles.

name: Chronic Granulomatous Disease
confirmatory_tests: Dihydrorhodamine 123 (DHR) flow cytometric neutrophil oxidative burst test
Nitroblue tetrazolium (NBT) slide test
CYBB, NCF1, NCF2, CYBA, NCF4 molecular mutation analysis
Histopathology of tissue biopsy showing non-caseating pigmented histiocytic granulomas
pubmed_title: Allogeneic HSCT and lentiviral gene therapy outcomes in chronic granulomatous disease.
